text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There we go, Grandma.
Let's try walking briskly to the other end of the room one more time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: One-two~, one-two~♪

text_block_list.name: Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Umamusume-san.
One-two, one-two...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Good job. So admirable. Even when your legs and back get stiff, you're trying so hard~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(Aye, it's not just Grandma—
everyone feels that way.)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: (—That she wants to try her best one more time.)

text_block_list.name: Acute's Father
text_block_list.text: Come on, aim right for the mitts! One-two! One-two!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap-clap, clap-clap!)

text_block_list.name: Acute's Father
text_block_list.text:
All right, looking good, looking good! Keep it up!
We're definitely going pro,
and aiming for champion!

text_block_list.name: Boxing Trainee
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm starting over!
My whole life, right from the beginning...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(Whether it's elderly grannies or young folks
stumbling through life... everyone is just the same.)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(Wishing to try again, without fail. If only I could
encourage people like that, even a little, through my races.)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Here, Grandma.
I'll keep you company too~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: One-two~, one-two~♪

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're working exceptionally hard today.
Keep that up...

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Wait, an Umamusume!?
Were you admitted to our clinic?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, I just happened to get lost and ended up here, is all~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for having me~.
Well then, I've got training to do, so I'll be off.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
I look forward to working with you again today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This Umamusume is Wonder Acute.
She's the dirt racer under my charge. And—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: They are also a benefactor who helped me back when I hit a wall as a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back in school—I was top of the class in seven subjects.
Yet that track record meant absolutely nothing here at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Far from producing results, she couldn't even find an Umamusume willing to accept her self-styled hardcore training."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (At this rate, I'm a failure as a Trainer...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (At this rate, I'm a total failure as a Trainer...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... Yeah, feeling pretty good.
My body's keeping up just fine
with your instructions, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Someone who meticulously readjusts the training menu
over and over to match my growth.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Always dedicating all of your own time for our sake—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
How could someone like that ever be a failure of a Trainer?
I'm living proof, having grown this much under your guidance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Wonder Acute signed a contract with me after I had been rejected time and again when scouting, and she accepted all of my coaching.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It's thanks to her that I gained the confidence
to believe I could make it as a Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to repay this kindness that saved me somehow.
This time, by lending a hand myself.
choice_data_list: Acute, tell me your dream again
Acute, please tell me your dream again

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "My dream? Well, that's already set in stone."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: By running in the Twinkle Series, I really wanna give strength to folks tryin' to get their lives back on track~. Like, for instance...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The young guys giving it their all
at the boxing gym Pops runs, and...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The grandpas and grandmas working hard
on their rehab at the hospital...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: If only I could somehow be an emotional support splint for people like that, you know?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So, I got to thinking.
Even if it takes a long, long time, I want to lead by example
and show how far steady effort can take you.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If someone as unimpressive as me can
conquer that dirt mountain, surely you'll
finally believe in me, right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: So Trainer, won't you find some way to take me all the way to the top?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: All the way to the top, where "that Umamusume" stands.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That Umamusume."
The Umamusume currently at the pinnacle of dirt is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Smart Falcon.
A front-runner known by the moniker
"The Silence Suzuka of Dirt."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Not only is she fast, but she also boasts immense popularity as an Umamusume idol—an "Umadol."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Truly an undisputed top Umamusume, shining at the absolute pinnacle. Even so—
choice_data_list: I'll catch up, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oho, think you can pull it off, Trainer-san?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's make your dream come true.
Yeah, let's make your dream come true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A gentle Umamusume who supports everyone's comeback.
If it's for the sake of Wonder Acute—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'd do anything for them.
If I have even a shred of talent
as a Trainer, that is.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, that makes me so happy.
For a Trainer like you, I should...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Here, have some of these crunchy treats.
Eat this up, and let's do our best together."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*crunch, crunch, crunch...*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Side by side, we munched on rice-bran-pickled radish.
The balance of sweet and spicy was just right.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I had this too, didn't I?
Trainer, care for a drink?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rumble rumble...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's tea too... There was tea. Unassuming as it may be,
a definite surge of energy soaks all the way to the soles of my feet.
With this strengthâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Let's climb all the way to the top of the dirt slope.
Tenaciously, inch by inch, the two of us together."
